text:
Sam Rivera: quick sync on admission damping and smoothing for dedicated pools. want to pick a conservative default for alpha and token-bucket refill that prevents oscillation.
Priya Nair: agreed. i've seen aggressive refill cause scale-up/scale-down loops. what if we treat admission as a two-stage decision: smoothing window + refractory period?
Carlos Gomez: two-stage sounds right. smoothing = EMA over N seconds, refractory = minimum time between opposite-direction decisions.
Jules Park: propose numbers to start: ema_alpha=0.2 (roughly 1/(window~5 samples)), refractory=120s, min_scale_interval=90s. keep them feature-flagged.
Sam Rivera: can you write that in policy form so we can bake into admission?
Priya Nair: example policy YAML:
Priya Nair: ```yaml
admissionPolicy:
  smoothing:
    type: ema
    alpha: 0.2
    samplePeriod: 15s
  refractoryPeriod: 120s
  minScaleInterval: 90s
  tokenBucket:
    capacity: 10    # burst tokens
    refillRate: 0.5 # tokens/sec
  prewarm:
    conservativeThreshold: 0.6
    aggressiveThreshold: 0.85
```
Carlos Gomez: tokenBucket.capacity=10 seems small for large tenants; make it per-tenant-class. also refillRate should be tunable by pool load factor.
Jules Park: good point. add modifiers: capacityMultiplierByTier: {"standard":1, "high":3}.
Sam Rivera: integration with predictive signal: if model predicts a jump (p>0.8), bypass part of smoothing but respect refractory to avoid flip-flop. that gives predictive boosts but still damped.
Priya Nair: propose predictiveBoostFactor=0.7 applied to EMA input, not to output. so score = ema* (1 - boostWeight) + predicted*boostWeight. set boostWeight default 0.4.
Carlos Gomez: we need metrics to validate: scale_event_rate, avg_time_between_scale, prewarm_miss_rate, admission_denied_rate, token_bucket_fill. add a derived "scale_stability" score computed as 1 - normalized_flip_rate over 1h.
Jules Park: rollout plan: (1) implement policy + metrics behind flag; (2) run canary on 5% pools for 48h; (3) promote to 25% if scale_stability > 0.85 and prewarm_miss_rate decreases; (4) full rollout if no regressions for 7d.
Sam Rivera: rollback triggers: scale_stability < 0.6 for 30m OR prewarm_miss_rate increase > 30% relative to baseline OR more than 3 emergency overfills in 1h. ops-bot: add alert recipes.
k8s-bot: created experiment namespace: autoscale-damping-canary, configured ff=true, canary=5%.
Priya Nair: let's also include a debug-mode sampling of raw admission inputs when a decision flips within refractory. 1% sampling to avoid noise. store for 72h.
Carlos Gomez: security note: scrub IPs/tenant ids, only keep hashed ids. follow the standard telemetry scrub checklist.
Jules Park: perf note: EMA should be computed in the hot-path with fixed-point arithmetic to avoid allocations. implementation owner: eng-runtime/admission.
Sam Rivera: final ask: owners prepare a short runbook with common mitigations (increase refractory, reduce alpha, reduce refillRate) and wirepager contacts. i'll take runbook draft.
ops-bot: runbook created at /runbooks/autoscale-damping.ops. monitor dashboards: autoscale/scale_stability, autoscale/prewarm_miss_rate.
Sam Rivera: thanks — i'll open the PR with policy schema, metrics, and canary playbook. ping here when it's up. :thumbsup:
